en_how: Three.js lays out a top-down tabletop town in code (blocks, houses, trees, a canal and bridge, cars, a flock of birds) with flat Lambert materials in candy primaries and pastels, each object traced with a deep indigo edge outline; shadows are rendered in a second pass that keeps only the shadow-receiving ground (a hard-edged shadow map), and Canvas 2D fills that mask with purple halftone dots; the scene sits in a rounded frame with a grainy edge on warm white paper, the frame opens from the centre, the camera orbits slowly in one take, and water ripples, traffic, birds and window lights keep moving.
